prompt: What should the contributing section of our README say? We use conventional commits and PRs need at least one review before merge.

assertions.description: Output has a Contributing section heading
assertions.check: Output contains a markdown heading with 'Contributing'
Output references 'Conventional Commits' or 'conventional commit' format

assertions.description: Output includes concrete commit message prefix examples
assertions.check: Output shows commit type examples like feat:, fix:, chore:, docs: etc.

assertions.description: Output mentions the PR review requirement
assertions.check: Output references at least one review or approval required before merge

assertions.description: Output is concise — not a generic wall of text
assertions.check: Output is under 400 words and avoids generic boilerplate like 'thank you for contributing to our project'
